judge.rationale: The candidate delivers a clean, bug-free implementation that meets every acceptance criterion in the issue. Like the reference, it renames the `afterModelResponse` hook parameter to `totalUsage` (and adds a JSDoc comment) while accumulating `inputTokens`, `outputTokens`, and `totalTokens` across all reporting rounds. Notably, the candidate tests a true two-tool-round turn (three provider calls total) as explicitly requested by the first acceptance criterion, whereas the reference only tested one tool round. The minor differences from the reference are placing `addUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` with unit tests, putting the orchestrator integration tests in a new acceptance test file instead of `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and keeping the updated spec points in the bottom section of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` without updating `CLAUDE.md` or `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md`.
